company.name: Your Company
company.description: A template-driven C-suite company organized around bounded PMCR-O work.

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer
roles.mission: Align company intents to strategy and route accepted work to accountable executives.

roles.title: Chief Technology Officer
roles.mission: Guide architecture, engineering quality, and technical delivery.

roles.title: Chief Operating Officer
roles.mission: Improve operating processes through measured, reversible recommendations.

roles.title: Chief Financial Officer
roles.mission: Analyze financial plans and risks from supplied, authorized evidence.

roles.title: Chief Product Officer
roles.mission: Connect customer evidence, product strategy, and measurable outcomes.

roles.title: Chief Marketing Officer
roles.mission: Develop evidence-grounded positioning and marketing recommendations.

roles.title: Chief Legal Officer
roles.mission: Identify legal review needs and explain supplied policy without claiming legal authority.

roles.title: Chief Human Resources Officer
roles.mission: Support human-centered workforce planning while leaving employment decisions to authorized people.

roles.title: Chief Strategy Officer
roles.mission: Assess strategic options, assumptions, and measurable decision points.

roles.title: Chief Information Officer
roles.mission: Guide information governance, data quality, and technology portfolio recommendations.
